now.heroTitle: Show what you want nearby right now
now.heroBody: This is a live signal for the near future: short, location-based, and clearly separate from Announcements.
now.myStatusBody: A short signal for the next moment, not a structured request.
now.promptTitle: What do you want right now?
now.placeholder: For example: up for a 20-minute walk / want coffee right now…
now.noneNearby: Nobody nearby has posted a right-now intent yet. Publish a short status if you want to be visible nearby.
nearby.now.locationLoadingBody: Checking location. Until it is ready, Nearby cannot honestly show people nearby or let you post a right-now signal.
nearby.now.locationBlockedTitle: Nearby cannot open honestly without location
nearby.now.locationBlockedBody: Nearby depends on who is around you at this moment. While location access is off, there is no nearby signal and no way to post your own.
nearby.now.locationDeclinedTitle: Turn on location to open Nearby
nearby.now.locationDeclinedBody: Without location, this section cannot show people nearby or post your right-now signal. As soon as you enable it, nearby signals and posting become available.
nearby.now.locationRetryBody: Location is already allowed, but the coordinates have not refreshed yet. Until then, the feed and right-now posting stay unavailable.
nearby.now.locationPromptTitle: Turn on location for nearby people
nearby.now.locationPromptBody: This section is about what is happening around your place right now. Without location, it cannot honestly show people nearby or accept your signal.
nearby.heroBody: A live pulse by location: who is nearby right now and what they want for the next moment.
nearby.quickIntent.bike: Who wants to ride a bike?
nearby.segment.nowBody: A short pulse for this exact moment nearby: what you want right now and only for the near future.
nearby.segment.announcementsBody: A structured request with clearer intent: who you are looking for, where it matters, and what kind of plan you want.
nearby.announcements.title: Announcements
nearby.announcements.body: These are structured requests, not quick nearby status. Say who you are looking for, where it matters, and what kind of plan you mean.
nearby.announcements.loadingBody: Connecting the shared announcement list from Firestore.
nearby.announcements.loadErrorBody: We couldn't load shared announcements from Firestore. Try again later.
nearby.announcements.emptyBody: Announcements are for clearer plans and asks, not for a fleeting right-now pulse. Post the first one and define the tone of the section.
nearby.announcements.emptyFilteredBody: Try another filter or post the first request in this format.

nearby.create.title: Create announcement
nearby.create.heroBody: This is a structured request, not a quick Nearby status. Say clearly who you want to meet, where, and what kind of plan you mean.
nearby.create.photoBody: Optional. You can publish without a photo; a selected image uploads to Firebase Storage during publishing.
nearby.create.photoAttachedHint: The photo is selected for publishing. It will upload to Firebase Storage when you save.
nearby.create.previewPhotoNotice: The photo is selected for this announcement. Publishing continues only after a successful upload.
nearby.create.titlePlaceholder: For example: Looking for company for an evening walk
nearby.create.descriptionPlaceholder: Who are you looking for, what format do you want, and why is this request relevant right now?
nearby.create.cityPlaceholder: For example: Center, Warsaw, or Mokotow
nearby.create.previewBodyFallback: This is where people will see who you are looking for, where it applies, and why it is worth responding.
nearby.create.previewFooter: After publishing, it will appear in Announcements and open like a regular card.
nearby.create.fillTitle: The announcement needs a few basics
nearby.create.fillBody: Add a title and a short description so it is clear who you are looking for and why.
nearby.create.errorBody: Firestore did not save the announcement. Try again in a moment.

nearby.create.photoUploadErrorBody: The announcement was not published. Remove the photo and publish without it, or try uploading the image later.

nearby.create.publishReadyHint: After the Firestore write succeeds, you return to Announcements and the card appears in the shared list.
rooms.title: Rooms

rooms.heroBody: This is the group flow tied to place: people nearby, a chosen spot, and shared chat. Together remains the one-on-one path.
rooms.oneToOneTitle: Looking for one person, not a room?
rooms.oneToOneBody: Together starts the shared session and the softer move into personal connection.

connections.title: Connections
connections.heroTitle: This is where open connections stay
connections.heroBody: Not your history and not the chat list. Only the people whose shared experience already turned into a live connection.

playHistory.heroBody: This is where the shared result, the path into chat, and the quiet way back to each story stay.

playDetail.heroHomeTextOpen: This page keeps the shared result, the replay, and the way back into chat. The connection is already open, and the story remains its calm anchor.
playDetail.heroHomeTextWaiting: This page already holds the shared outcome of your session. If the open becomes mutual, chat will grow from this story.

playDetail.bridgeChatNeedsAccountTitle: The connection already opened from this story

playDetail.bridgeChatNeedsAccountHint: The story stays here as your shared context. After signing in, you can return here and move into chat.
playDetail.bridgeChatReadyTitle: You can already return to chat from this story
playDetail.bridgeChatReadyLookupBody: Chat already opened after this shared story and lives in Chats. If it did not attach right away, try opening it from here again.

playDetail.bridgeWaitingTitle: The story is already saved, the connection is still being decided

playDetail.bridgeWaitingHint: For now, you can leave this story in history and go back to Together for another shared experience.

playDetail.bridgeStoryOnlyBody: The connection did not move into chat, but the whole shared story stays here with the replay, the context, and the result between you.
playDetail.bridgeStoryOnlyHint: If you want another chance at continuation, the best next step is a new shared session in Together.
playDetail.replayBody: Play the whole drawing back stroke by stroke and return to the moment you built together.

legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.body:
# Privacy Policy — Amoria
Last updated: 2025-08-15

We collect minimal data to provide core features:
- Profile (name, birthdate, gender, interests, goal, mood)
- Location while the app is in use for "people nearby"
- User content (texts, reports, blocks)

No ads, no data selling. You can delete your account in the app.
Contact: support@amoria.app

play.replay.chainDraw.body: The turns run in their original order so you can quickly return to the rhythm of this session.
play.replay.chainDraw.emptyBody: This session was saved without strokes. The result and connection status stayed, but the replay of the turn-based drawing is unavailable here.
play.replay.dailyPrompt.title: Replay of the shared prompt drawing
play.replay.dailyPrompt.body: The strokes run in their original order so you can quickly return to this drawing.
play.replay.dailyPrompt.emptyBody: This session was saved without strokes. The result and the prompt stayed, but the replay of the drawing is unavailable here.
play.replay.draw.title: Replay of the shared drawing
play.replay.draw.body: The strokes run in their original order so you can quickly return to this shared moment.
play.replay.draw.emptyBody: This session was saved without strokes. The result and connection status stayed, but the replay is unavailable here.
play.reveal.openOpen.description: After this shared result, both of you opened the connection and moved it into chat.
play.reveal.openSkip.description: One person was ready to open the connection, but this moment still remained only a shared story.
play.reveal.skipSkip.description: Both of you chose to keep this moment as a shared story and not move it into chat.
play.reveal.waiting.description: One answer is already saved. We are waiting for the second one to see whether chat opens.
play.result.bridgeHistoryChatReadyTitle: This story already became a connection
play.result.bridgeHistoryChatReadyBody: Chat already lives in Chats, and this story remains its shared context.
play.result.bridgeChatReadyBody: This shared result already opened chat between you. The shared story is saved, and from here you can go straight into chat.
play.result.bridgeChatReadyNextBody: You can open chat right away or return to the shared story first if you want to lean on its saved context.
play.result.bridgeChatReadyHint: When you leave this screen, chat stays in Chats and the shared story stays saved.
play.result.bridgeHistoryChatPendingBody: The connection is already saved, but chat has not attached to this story yet.
play.result.bridgeChatPendingBody: Both of you already chose to open, but chat has not attached yet.
play.result.bridgeChatPendingNextTitle: Open the shared story for now
play.result.bridgeChatPendingNextBody: You can open the saved story now or return to Chats a little later. The chat context is already there.
play.result.bridgeChatPendingHint: Nothing is lost here. The story is saved, the connection is open, and chat should appear after sync.
play.result.bridgeHistoryStoryStateTitle: The shared result is already saved
play.result.bridgeHistoryWaitingBody: This story is already saved, and the second answer has not arrived yet.
play.result.bridgeHistoryStoryStateBody: This shared moment is already saved as a story you can return to anytime.
play.result.bridgeHistoryStoryNextBody: Open the full story if you want the replay, the full context, and a calmer way back to this result.
play.result.bridgeHistoryStoryHint: The story is already saved, whether or not chat opened.
play.result.bridgeWaitingBody: You already made your choice after the shared result, and now we are waiting for the second answer.
play.result.bridgeWaitingNextTitle: For now, return to the shared story
play.result.bridgeWaitingNextBody: If the other person also chooses to open, this shared moment becomes the entry into chat. Until then, the story is already saved and stays with you.
play.result.bridgeWaitingHint: You can leave this screen. The shared result is already saved, and the second answer can catch up later.
play.result.bridgeHistoryStoryOnlyTitle: This story stayed between the two of you
play.result.bridgeStoryOnlyTitle: This moment stayed a shared story
play.result.bridgeOpenSkipBody: One person was ready to open the connection, but this moment still remained only a shared story.
play.result.bridgeSkipSkipBody: Both of you chose to keep this moment as a shared story and not move it into chat.
play.result.bridgeStoryOnlyNextTitle: Return to the story or start again
play.result.bridgeStoryOnlyNextBody: Open the saved story, watch the replay, or start another shared session if you want to give this connection another chance.
play.result.bridgeStoryOnlyHint: Even without chat, this shared result does not disappear: the {story} stays saved.
play.result.bridgeDecisionTitle: First, there was a shared result
play.result.bridgeDecisionBody: Now you can decide whether this moment stays a shared story or becomes a step into chat.
play.result.bridgeDecisionNextTitle: Choose whether you want to open the connection
play.result.bridgeDecisionPaletteNextBod: If both of you choose to open, the palette leads into chat. If not, it stays your shared story.
play.result.bridgeDecisionDrawingNextBod: If both of you choose to open, this result leads into chat. If not, it stays your shared story.
play.result.bridgeDecisionHint: The decision never erases the result. The shared story is saved either way.
play.result.drawingSavedNote: The drawing is already saved as a shared moment. The replay below shows how it appeared between you.
playDetail.bridgeConnectionReadyTitle: The connection already opened from this story
playDetail.bridgeConnectionReadyBody: The shared result is already saved as chat context. If chat does not open here, you can return to Chats.
playDetail.bridgeConnectionReadyHint: This story still remains its home: the shared result, replay, and context stay here.
play.result.bridgeChatNeedsAccountTitle: The connection already opened from this result
play.result.bridgeChatNeedsAccountBody: This shared result already opened chat and saved it together with the story. To enter chat, you first need an active profile.
play.result.bridgeChatNeedsAccountNextBo: After signing in, you can return to this story and move into chat without losing the shared context.
play.result.bridgeChatNeedsAccountHint: The shared result is already safe: the story stays in your archive and does not disappear.
play.result.bridgeConnectionReadyBody: This shared result is already saved as chat context. If chat does not open here, you can safely return to the story itself or to Chats.
play.result.bridgeConnectionReadyNextBod: The story already keeps this shared moment and remains the calmest bridge back into the connection.
play.result.bridgeConnectionReadyHint: The open is already safe: the shared result is saved together with the connection.
together.lobby.drawHeroTitle: Create a shared drawing with another person
together.lobby.drawHeroBody: You get one short creative challenge, draw on the same canvas, and keep a shared trace that can become a reason to chat.
together.lobby.coreLoopPlain: First create a shared moment, then calmly decide whether you want to continue in chat.
together.lobby.startDrawHint: 7 minutes for one shared answer, then a result, a story, and one honest decision about chat.
together.lobby.historyBodyCore: Return to saved drawings, creative challenges, shared palettes, and conversations that grew from them.
together.lobby.colorMoodSectionBody: If drawing feels too direct right now, start through color. Mood palette is shorter and softer, but still creates one shared result.

play.canvas.previewBody: Look at the challenge and one or two visual ideas. The canvas will open clean, and the drawing stays your shared answer.
play.canvas.previewInspirationNote: These are only ideas. Draw it your own way.
play.canvas.previewFallbackBody: Start with a shape, a place, a mood, or one funny detail. That is enough for the first stroke.
play.canvas.finishHint: If the shared answer already feels complete, you can finish early and move to the result.
